currency.description: Alpha currency ID, for example USDS02b5a8dd2f59a098, not the display symbol USDS. First call GET /alpha/currencies without currency, match the token by name, chain and address, and use the returned currency field. Paginate with page and limit. Use cex_alpha_list_alpha_currencies without currency to obtain the currency field.

limit.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single list
